gesture_descriptions.HELLO: Open hand, palm facing forward, gentle side-to-side waving motion.
gesture_descriptions.THANK YOU: Flat hand moves forward from chin toward recipient; palm tilted slightly forward.
gesture_descriptions.HELP: Fist with thumb upright (thumbs up pose placed firmly on base hand).
gesture_descriptions.YES: Closed fist nodding up and down repeatedly like a head nod.
gesture_descriptions.NO: Index and middle fingers snap down to touch thumb; ring and pinky tucked.
gesture_descriptions.REST_OR_NOISE: Idle hand resting or indeterminate transitioning movement.

rejection_message: Unrecognized gesture - please repeat gesture clearly.
